1:1: “Yahweh” is God’s proper Name, sometimes rendered “LORD” (all caps) in other translations.
1:3: “Behold”, from “הִנֵּה”, means look at, take notice, observe, see, or gaze at. It is often used as an interjection.
1:10: Beth Ophrah means literally “House of Dust.”
6:10: An ephah is a measure of volume (about 22 liters or about 2/3 of a bushel), and a short ephah is made smaller than a full ephah for the purpose of cheating customers.
